1	# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
    10	Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
    11	CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"
    12	
    13	## Top Bar Promo
    14	Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    15	CTA: "Learn More" → links to Digital Platform page
    16	
    17	## Community Promo
    18	Heading: "Join the Hustle"
    19	Body: "Welcome to RedRoom. More than a workout — it's a movement. Our global community of athletes, first-timers, and everyone in between push limits together in the Red Room. Show up. Work hard. Earn your place."
    20	CTA: "Explore the Community"
    21	
    22	## Two Ways to Red Room
    23	Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
    24	Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
    25	Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."
    26	
    27	## The Workout — Method Overview
    28	Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
    29	Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."
    30	
    31	## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
    32	Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
    33	**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
    34	**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."
    35	
    36	## Weekly Class Schedule
    37	
    38	| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
    39	|---|---|
    40	| Monday | Chest & Back |
    41	| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
    42	| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
    43	| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
    44	| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
    45	| Saturday | Full Body |
    46	
    47	## Studio Experience
    48	Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
    49	Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
    50	CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."
    51	
    52	## Free Trial CTA
    53	Heading: "JOIN US FOR A FREE 30 DAY TRIAL"
    54	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial"
    55	
    56	## Instructor Roster
    57	
    58	Instructors are displayed as a filterable card grid. Each card shows: instructor name, home studio, and a "Book a Class" link.
    59	
    60	**Filter by location:** All Locations · New York · Los Angeles · London · Miami · San Francisco
    61	
    62	Sample instructors:
    63	- **Dani Reyes** — New York
    64	- **Marcus Cole** — Los Angeles
    65	- **Priya Nair** — London
    66	- **Jordan Voss** — Miami
    67	- **Tessa Kim** — San Francisco
    68	- **Andre Williams** — New York
    69	- **Sofia Marquez** — Los Angeles
    70	- **Liam Chen** — London
    71	
    72	CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"
    73	
    74	## RIDE FAQ Content
    75	
    76	| Question | Answer |
    77	|---|---|
    78	| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
    79	| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
    80	| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
    81	| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
    82	| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
    83	| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |
    84	
    85	## Digital Platform Features
    86	
    87	Heading: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
    88	
    89	- **World Class Workouts On Your Time** — Access RedRoom's signature HIIT classes filmed with top instructors. Treadmill, floor, and full-body formats available on demand.
    90	- **Workouts That Push You to Your Limits** — Strength, cardio, abs, stretching, and more. New classes added weekly across multiple categories and difficulty levels.
    91	- **Unlimited Access** — One membership, unlimited streaming. No caps on how many classes you take per week.
    92	- **30 Day Free Trial** — Try the full digital library free for 30 days. Cancel anytime.
    93	- **Anytime, Anywhere** — Stream on your phone, tablet, laptop, or TV. Your Red Room, wherever you are.
    94	
    95	CTA: "Join the Fit Fam Today" | "Start Your Free Trial"
    96	
    97	## Lifestyle Carousel
    98	A swipeable image carousel showcasing the RedRoom lifestyle — studio action shots, community events, post-workout moments, and branded apparel. Navigable via left/right arrows or swipe gestures.
    99	
   100	## Newsletter Signup
   101	Heading: "Newsletter Form Signup"
   102	Body: "Stay in the know. Get workout tips, class updates, and exclusive offers delivered to your inbox."
   103	Fields: Email address
   104	CTA: "Subscribe"
   105	Validation: Email format check; confirmation message on success.
   106	
   107	## Footer Navigation
   108	**Explore:** The Workout · Instructors · RIDE FAQ · Digital Platform · Community Events
   109	**Company:** Our Studios · Global Expansion · Fuel Bar · Blog · Careers
   110	**Connect:** Shop · My Account · Download the App (iOS / Android)
   111	**Country Selector:** Dropdown with available regions (US, UK, Australia, Canada, etc.)
   112	
   113	## Global Navigation
   114	Primary nav items: The Workout · Instructors · RedRoom RIDE · RedRoom X (Digital) · The Community · Our Studios · First Timers
   115	Utility nav: Book Now · Buy Classes · Shop · My Account

1 --- 2 name: web-frameworks 3 description: Build modern full-stack web applications with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, RSC, PPR, SSR, SSG, ISR), Turborepo (monorepo management, task pipelines, remote caching, parallel execution), and RemixIcon (3100+ SVG icons in outlined/filled styles). Use when creating React applications, implementing server-side rendering, setting up monorepos with multiple packages, optimizing build performance and caching strategies, adding icon libraries, managing shared dependencies, or working with TypeScript full-stack projects. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # Web Frameworks Skill Group 9 10 Comprehensive guide for building modern full-stack web applications using Next.js, Turborepo, and RemixIcon. 11 12 ## Overview 13 14 This skill group combines three powerful tools for web development: 15 16 **Next.js** - React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features 17 **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript 18 **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons 19 20 ## When to Use This Skill Group 21 22 - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React 23 - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages 24 - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation 25 - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching 26 - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography 27 - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects 28 - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization 29 30 ## Stack Selection Guide 31 32 ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon 33 34 Use when building a standalone application: 35 - E-commerce sites 36 - Marketing websites 37 - SaaS applications 38 - Documentation sites 39 - Blogs and content platforms 40 41 **Setup:** 42 ```bash 43 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 44 cd my-app 45 npm install remixicon 46 ``` 47 48 ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon 49 50 Use when building multiple applications with shared code: 51 - Microfrontends 52 - Multi-tenant platforms 53 - Internal tools with shared component library 54 - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic 55 - Design system with documentation site 56 57 **Setup:** 58 ```bash 59 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 60 # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory 61 # Install remixicon in shared UI packages 62 ``` 63 64 ### Framework Features Comparison 65 66 | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | 67 |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| 68 | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | 69 | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | 70 | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | 71 | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | 72 73 ## Quick Start 74 75 ### Next.js Application 76 77 ```bash 78 # Create new project 79 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 80 cd my-app 81 82 # Install RemixIcon 83 npm install remixicon 84 85 # Import in layout 86 # app/layout.tsx 87 import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' 88 89 # Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app 151 │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app 152 │ └── docs/ # Documentation site 153 ├── packages/ 154 │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon 155 │ ├── api-client/ # API client library 156 │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs 157 │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types 158 └── turbo.json # Build pipeline 159 ``` 160 161 **turbo.json:** 162 ```json 163 { 164 "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", 165 "pipeline": { 166 "build": { 167 "dependsOn": ["^build"], 168 "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] 169 }, 170 "dev": { 171 "cache": false, 172 "persistent": true 173 }, 174 "lint": {}, 175 "test": { 176 "dependsOn": ["build"] 177 } 178 } 179 } 180 ``` 181 182 ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library 183 184 ```tsx 185 // packages/ui/src/button.tsx 186 import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" 187 188 export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { 189 return ( 190 194 ) 195 } 196 197 // apps/web/app/page.tsx 198 import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" 199 import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" 200 201 export default function Page() { 202 return 203 } 204 ``` 205 206 ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching 207 208 ```tsx 209 // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx 210 import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' 211 212 // Static generation at build time 213 export async function generateStaticParams() { 214 const posts = await getPosts() 215 return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) 216 } 217 218 // Revalidate every hour 219 async function getPost(slug: string) { 220 const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { 221 next: { revalidate: 3600 } 222 }) 223 if (!res.ok) return null 224 return res.json() 225 } 226 227 export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { 228 const post = await getPost(params.slug) 229 if (!post) notFound() 230 231 return
{post.content}
232 } 233 ``` 234 235 ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline 236 237 ```yaml 238 # .github/workflows/ci.yml 239 name: CI 240 on: [push, pull_request] 241 242 jobs: 243 build: 244 runs-on: ubuntu-latest 245 steps: 246 - uses: actions/checkout@v4 247 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 248 with: 249 node-version: 18 250 - run: npm install 251 - run: npx turbo run build test lint 252 env: 253 TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} 254 TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} 255 ``` 256 257 ## Utility Scripts 258 259 Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: 260 261 **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices 262 **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo 263 264 Usage examples: 265 ```bash 266 # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup 267 python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router 268 269 # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run 270 python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run 271 272 # Run tests 273 cd scripts/tests 274 pytest 275 ``` 276 277 ## Best Practices 278 279 **Next.js:** 280 - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed 281 - Implement proper loading and error states 282 - Use Image component for automatic optimization 283 - Set proper metadata for SEO 284 - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) 285 286 **Turborepo:** 287 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) 288 - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) 289 - Configure outputs for proper caching 290 - Enable remote caching for team collaboration 291 - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only 292 293 **RemixIcon:** 294 - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis 295 - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering 296 - Provide aria-labels for accessibility 297 - Use currentColor for flexible theming 298 - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons 299 300 ## Resources 301 302 - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt 303 - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs 304 - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com 305 306 ## Implementation Checklist 307 308 Building with this stack: 309 310 - [ ] Create project structure (single app or monorepo) 311 - [ ] Configure TypeScript and ESLint 312 - [ ] Set up Next.js with App Router 313 - [ ] Configure Turborepo pipeline (if monorepo) 314 - [ ] Install and configure RemixIcon 315 - [ ] Implement routing and layouts 316 - [ ] Add loading and error states 317 - [ ] Configure image and font optimization 318 - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns 319 - [ ] Configure caching strategies 320 - [ ] Add API routes as needed 321 - [ ] Implement shared component library (if monorepo) 322 - [ ] Configure remote caching (if monorepo) 323 - [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline 324 - [ ] Configure deployment platform

steps.message:
The RedRoom Fitness 5-page corporate website has been built and exported to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

## Pages Built
| Page | File | Key Sections |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Home** | `index.html` | Hero, Community Promo, Two Ways, Studio Experience, Free Trial CTA, Lifestyle Carousel, Newsletter, Footer |
| **The Workout** | `the-workout.html` | Hero, Method Overview, Weekly Schedule Table, Floor/Treadmill Toggle, Studio Experience, CTA, Newsletter, Footer |
| **Instructors** | `instructors.html` | Hero, Location Filter Chips, Instructor Grid, CTA, Newsletter, Footer |
| **RIDE FAQ** | `ride-faq.html` | Hero, FAQ Accordion (single-open), Newsletter, Footer |
| **Digital Platform** | `digital-platform.html` | Hero, Features Overview, Workout Types, Unlimited Access Stats, CTA, Newsletter, Footer |

## Interactions Implemented
- **Home Carousel** — Smooth sliding transitions with prev/next arrows, dot indicators, and auto-advance
- **Floor/Treadmill Toggle** — Seamless tab switch with animated content fade
- **Instructor Location Filter** — Dynamic grid filtering by city (All, New York, LA, London, Miami, SF)
- **FAQ Accordion** — Single-open behavior; clicking a question collapses others
- **Newsletter Validation** — Inline email format validation with success/error feedback
- **Country Selector** — Footer dropdown with selectable regions

## Design System
- **Colors:** `#141414` (background), `#FF0000` (primary accent), `#FFFFFF` (text)
- **Typography:** Oswald (display/headlines), Inter (body)
- **Style:** Dark mode by default, full responsive breakpoints, sticky nav with red promo bar, gradient CTAs

All files are in `/app/output/` and openable directly in a browser with no build step required.
